title: AI Mode
subtitle: Ask about your customers, campaigns and revenue. Nothing happens until you confirm.
how.1: Write in Arabic, English or a mix of both. Saudi dialect is fine.
how.2: I reply in the language you write in, unless you pick a reply language above.
how.3: I never send, activate or refund anything until you press Confirm.
how.4: I can make mistakes, so read each summary before you confirm.
